products.notes: ZERO CONFLICTS. This is the best-populated row encountered so far in this pass, and every DB value that the documents cover is confirmed exactly. Confirmations worth recording: max_payload=240 (technical-data p.2 'Tragfähigkeit ... 240 kg bei Standardkonfiguration' AND 'Max. Nutzlast gesamt max. 240 kg (24 Behälter à 10 kg)' — stated twice, plus advantages p.1 'Tragfähigkeit: 240 kg', three independent occurrences); max_speed=1.5 (technical-data p.2 'Höchstgeschwindigkeit 1,5 m/s'); vehicle_length=2230 / vehicle_width=1060 (technical-data p.2 'Abmessungen (L × B × H) 2.230 × 1.060 × 2.160 mm'); omnidirectional_movement=true (technical-data p.2 'Antriebsmechanik omnidirektionaler Antrieb'); ingress_protection_rating=IP20 (technical-data p.2 'Schutzklasse IP 20'); operating_humidity_max=95 (technical-data p.2 'Luftfeuchtigkeit < 95%, nicht kondensierend'); battery_type=Li-Ion (technical-data p.2 'Akku 8× Li-Ion, 25,6 V, je 21 Ah'); battery_runtime=8.0 (technical-data p.2 'Arbeitszeit ohne Laden bis zu 8 Stunden'); charge_time=96 min (technical-data p.2 'Ladezeit 1,6 Stunden (Verhältnis 5:1)' — 1,6 h × 60 = 96 min, i.e. the DB value already carries the correct h→min conversion); lift_height=1700 (technical-data p.2 'Max. Greifhöhe 1.700 mm', corroborated advantages p.1 'Hubhöhe: 400–1.700 mm'); onboard_container_count=24 (technical-data p.2 'Max. Anzahl der KLTs pro Roboter 8 (600 × 400 mm) – 24 (300 × 200 mm / 400 × 300 mm)'); onboard_ui=true (technical-data p.2 'Benutzerschnittstelle 2 x Touch-Displays, LEDs'); vda5050_compatible + integration_capability WMS/REST API (technical-data p.2 'Integration über VDA 5050 möglich, alternativ Anbindung des Magazino Fleet Manager über standardisierte REST-Schnittstelle an das WMS'); multi_fleet_capable (advantages p.2 'Das ermöglicht den Einsatz der Mobile Robots unter herstellerunabhängigen Leitsystemen'); picking_mechanism=Conveyor-integrated (advantages p.3 'Adaptive Förderbandgreifer für KLTs'); safety_coverage=Limited 3D (technical-data p.2 '2D-Laserscanner und 3D-Kameras zur dynamischen Kollisionsvermeidung', advantages p.2 'Vier Laserscanner und zwei 3D-Kameras'). OPERATING TEMPERATURE — the DB got this RIGHT, unlike the MiR rows: technical-data p.2 states 'Temperatur 15 °C – 25 °C' and separately 'Max. Temperatur (kurzzeitig, bis zu 1 h) 35 °C'. The DB stores operating_temp_max=25, i.e. the CONTINUOUS figure, not the 1-hour peak — exactly the convention this pass recommended for MiR. Worth citing when that ruling is made. TURNING GEOMETRY — CONFIRMED CORRECT, no conflict: technical-data p.2 prints 'Min. Wendekreis 3.100 mm'. 'Wendekreis' is a turning CIRCLE (diameter), so the DB's min_turning_radius=1550 (exactly half) is right. The footprint-diagonal check corroborates it independently: with a 2.230 × 1.060 m body the circumscribed-circle diameter is √(2230²+1060²) ≈ 2469 mm, so a 3100 mm RADIUS (6200 mm swept circle) would be physically impossible while a 3100 mm diameter → 1550 mm radius sits just above the 1235 mm geometric minimum. Note the AP0 hint's '0 if omnidirectional' would be actively misleading here — SOTO IS omnidirectional (technical-data p.2) yet still sweeps a 3.1 m circle because of its 2.23 m body. NOT MAPPED — AP0 SCOPE GAP (recurring): technical-data p.2 prints 'Min. Breite für sichere Geschwindigkeit (0,3 m/s) / für Höchstgeschwindigkeit  1.650 mm / 2.510 mm' — an explicit aisle-width pair on the same speed axis seen at KNAPP — but min_aisle_width is Forklift/Tugger scope only, so neither figure is storable for a Mobile AMR. NON-CONFORMING VALUE ALREADY IN THE DB: cleanroom_class is stored as 'ISO 1-9' with an ASCII hyphen, whereas AP0's allowed value is 'ISO 1–9' with an EN DASH — a string-equality mismatch that could silently fail allowed-values validation. The underlying fact is right and more specific than AP0 can express: technical-data p.2 states 'Reinraumzertifizierung  ISO-7-Zertifikat' (a specific ISO class 7). INTERPRETIVE MAPPING WORTH A REVIEWER'S EYE (not changed): floor_flatness_req is stored as 'Standard (FM2)', but the source (technical-data p.2) actually names a different standard — 'Bodenqualität: Industrieboden, Ebenheitsabweichung nach DIN 18202:2019-07' — plus 'Höhe der befahrbaren Bodenunebenheiten 5 mm'. A standard IS named, so the field is correctly non-null, but DIN 18202 is a German building-tolerance standard rather than an FM classification; the FM2 bucket is an interpretation. NOT MAPPED — no AP0 field: 'Eigengewicht 686–735 kg'; the +80 mm laser-scanner height addendum; 'Mind. Greifhöhe (frontal / seitlich) 500 mm / 400 mm'; supported KLT footprints (300×200 / 400×300 / 600×400 mm) and heights (80–320 mm); 'Unterstützte Normen VDA 4500 (R-KLT, RL-KLT)'; 'Max. Gewicht pro KLT max. 20 kg'; 'Schwerpunkt der Ladung max. 2/3 zu einer Seite'; 'Drehung des KLT im Inneren des Roboters +/– 180° und +/– 90°'; 'Höhe der befahrbaren Bodenunebenheiten 5 mm'; battery detail (8× 25,6 V / 21 Ah); 'Lichtvorhänge schützen den Innenraum', 'LED-Warnlichter' (advantages p.3); 'Doppeltiefes Transportsystem' (advantages p.3); the 'Jungheinrich Li-ion Guarantee Plus' 8-year battery warranty (advantages p.2). LEFT NULL DELIBERATELY: navigation_type — the DB has 'Natural Feature (SLAM)' and the documents say only 'Lasergestützte Navigation und 3D-Kamerasysteme' plus 'Mithilfe von künstlicher Intelligenz passt sich der Mobile Robot an Veränderungen in der Umgebung an' (advantages p.3). That is consistent with SLAM and inconsistent with fixed reflectors, but it never names the technology, so nothing was added or changed. installation_process — advantages p.3 says 'unterstützen wir unsere Kundschaft vor Ort bei der reibungslosen Integration', which does not clearly assign who may install.
